job-boards.greenhouse.io/semafor/jobs/47.description_excerpt:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

The Role

Semafor is hiring an exceptional Lead Editor for its signature briefing, Flagship. Aimed at the core Semafor audience — senior executives, decision makers, and policymakers — Flagship distills the biggest, most important, and interesting news from across the world into tight, analytically rich, and deeply contextualized updates for sophisticated, time-poor readers. Its core strength is that it is complex, comprehensive, and completable.

The successful candidate will help run this product and infuse the Flagship sensibility across the Semafor newsroom, its products, site, and app. They will both write and edit with fluidity and should be armed in particular with strong associative intelligence — able to tie together complex ideas and seemingly disparate developments — alongside a deep understanding of the factors driving global geoeconomics, particularly when it comes to developments in technology, business, economics, finance, and trade. The Lead Editor will be skilled at making connections, implicit and explicit, across themes, geographies, and industries, while also bringing delight to readers’ daily lives. They will handle the news with sobriety and historical nuance.

The successful candidate will report to the Global Managing Editor, as part of a team of contributors worldwide, helping drive both daily editions of Flagship. They will be based in London.

Your responsibilities

  • Work with Semafor journalists to shape Flagship’s tone and coverage, and write most of it on a daily basis in the UK morning.
  • Support the production of the edition that publishes in the US evening with insights and ideas.
  • Collaborate across the Semafor newsroom, working with all our teams and verticals, contributing broadly to coverage beyond Flagship — in particular by writing, editing, or assigning stories.
  • Help lead the conception and execution of a Semafor app.
  • Write smart, sophisticated, analytically hefty updates for an elite audience.
  • Participate in event moderation, as well as media appearances on TV, radio, and podcasts.

What makes you qualified

  • 5 to 10 years of journalism experience, with a track record of major writing roles or leadership of high-level newsletters or briefings.
  • Experience and interest in global financial and business journalism.
  • A strategic, sophisticated approach to identifying themes and focuses of coverage across sectors and borders.
  • Bring speedy insight to big news stories, and flair and personality to writing.
  • A passion for world events and issues and a broad interest in a wide range of subjects.
  • Broad media consumption habits across conventional and unconventional sources.
  • Eagerness to be part of a dynamic work environment demanding initiative, flexibility, and a willingness to jump in wherever needed to help the team succeed.
  • Experience working with diverse teams with teammates from many different backgrounds.
  • Diligence and reliability to work without hands-on supervision.
  • The ability to think constantly about story distribution and audiences, across many forms of media and platforms.

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. About SoundCloud

What's next in music happens on SoundCloud first. As the world’s largest open audio platform, SoundCloud is powered by a connected community of creators, listeners, and curators who share, discover, and influence what’s new, now, and next in music and audio.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Ads ML (Machine Learning) team within the Growth, Revenue and Commerce group, and to take SoundCloud's ad delivery into the machine learning era.

Advertising is one of SoundCloud's core revenue streams. It earns money directly, and it is also one of the main ways free listeners discover and move to a paid subscription. That revenue pays creators on our platform, covers content costs, and keeps SoundCloud a healthy, independent company. Getting ad delivery right matters to listeners, artists, and the business.

Our team builds the systems that decide which ads SoundCloud listeners hear and see, how many, and when. We're replacing fixed rules with ML: contextual bandits and predictive models (churn risk, subscription propensity, user LTV) that set ad load for each listener in real time. The goal is more ad revenue without hurting retention, and you'll decide how far and how fast we get there.

This is a hybrid leadership role with a strong hands-on component. You'll lead a team of four backend and ML engineers, contribute directly to the codebase, and own the technical direction of machine learning driven ad delivery. You'll work closely with client engineers, data analysts, and product, and report to the Director of Engineering in a flat structure.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the ML roadmap for ad delivery. Take personalised ad serving (contextual bandits, churn and subscription-propensity models) from experiment to production across markets, and decide what the team builds next.
  • Own the production ML stack behind ad decisions: online model serving, real-time bandit decisioning, feature pipelines, and model evaluation and monitoring.
  • Build a rigorous experimentation practice for ML: offline and online evaluation, A/B test design, guardrail metrics, and clear ship-or-hold decisions on ad load and user LTV.
  • Own the backend ad delivery services that turn model decisions into the ads served on iOS, Android and web.
  • Partner with client engineers, data analysts and product on the roadmap, balancing revenue, retention and ad inventory.
  • Grow the team's ML depth through hiring, mentorship and career development, and manage performance effectively.

Background & Experience:

  • 2+ years of engineering management experience.
  • 5+ years as a backend software developer. You're comfortable writing code, discussing trade-offs and taking part in system design.
  • Hands-on experience building and running ML systems in production: model serving, real-time decisioning, feature pipelines, and monitoring for model drift and data quality.
  • Solid grasp of applied ML for decision-making (bandits, ranking, recommendation or propensity models), deep enough to challenge modelling choices and trade-offs with the team.
  • Strong experiment design skills, including statistical rigour and the trade-off between short-term revenue and long-term retention.
  • Experience managing engineers, including coaching, feedback and performance development.
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including explaining ML trade-offs in business terms.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in ad tech, ad serving or large-scale experimentation on a large consumer platform.
  • Contextual or multi-armed bandits, reinforcement learning or uplift modelling in production.
  • ML platform tooling: feature stores, model registries and workflow
  • User LTV, churn or subscription-propensity modelling.
  • Ad standards and integrations: VAST, programmatic demand (SSPs and DSPs), frequency capping.
  • Audio or video advertising.
  • Scala or another JVM language, and Python for ML work.

If you're excited about bringing machine learning to ad delivery at scale, leading a team, and shaping how millions of listeners experience ads on SoundCloud, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Sumo Logic

You’ll build a career. The SDR role teaches discovery, listening, presenting, and objection handling, plus fluency in security, observability, and AI. You’ll work closely with account executives, with clear paths to AE, sales engineering, or leadership.
